groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: 亻 on the left: a person doing something.

chars.story: A person at his old, familiar task: do.
chars.note: Also 'make' (做饭 'cook') and 'be': 做老师. 作 is the written cousin.

chars.story: A person standing by his words: trust.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. Also 'letter': 写信 'write a letter'.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 呆 child (口 head + 木 body)
chars.story: A person with a child strapped on his back: protect.
A person bent under a load asks: why should I?
chars.note: His Analects card: 'what / how'. Now formal: 如何 'how', 任何 'any', 为何 'why'.

chars.story: A person and an ox, each counted on its own: one item.
chars.note: A counter for matters and clothes: 一件事, 一件衣服.

chars.story: A person handing the spindle on to the next: pass on.
chars.note: Traditional 傳: 專 became 专.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: 扌 is 手 squeezed onto the left: an action of the hand.

chars.story: A hand clamped round a handle: hold.
chars.note: Grammar: 把 + thing + verb puts the thing first: 把门关上 'shut the door'.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 立 stand + 女 woman
chars.story: A hand reaching out to the woman standing there: receive.
chars.note: Also 'connect' and 'meet' someone: 接人.

chars.story: A hand that keeps the temple going year after year: maintain.
A hand driving in a nail: hit.
chars.note: A general verb for many actions: 打电话 'phone', 打球 'play ball'.

chars.story: A hand resting on the place you live, what you rely on: according to.
chars.note: Traditional 據: 豦 became 居.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 𠬝 kneeling man held by a hand
chars.story: A hand bringing the kneeling man before the court: report.
chars.note: Traditional 報: 幸 'handcuffs' on the left became 扌. Also 'repay': 回报.

groups.title: words 讠
groups.note: 讠 is 言 cut down to two strokes: speech.

chars.story: Words wagging off the tongue: speech.
chars.note: After a clause, 的话 means 'if'. Traditional 話.

chars.parts: 讠 words + 殳 hand with a tool
chars.story: Orders given and a hand with tools: set it up.
chars.note: Also 'suppose': 假设.

chars.parts: 讠 words + 仑 in order
chars.story: Words laid out in order: an argument, a theory.
chars.note: Also 'discuss': 讨论, 论文 'paper'. Traditional 論.

chars.story: Words about what is right: discuss.
chars.note: His card is 議: 訁 became 讠 and 義 became 义.

chars.story: Words set down in your own hand: record.
chars.note: Also 'remember': 记得, 忘记 'forget'. Traditional 記.

groups.title: eye 目 and see 见
groups.note: 目 is an eye; 见 is an eye on legs.

chars.story: An eye stood on end.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. Also 'item': 项目, 节目 'programme'.

chars.parts: - an eye on two legs, cut down from 見
chars.story: An eye walking on legs: going to see.
chars.note: His card is 見: the 目 on top became a narrow frame.

chars.story: Seeing what is set on the altar, and judging it: look upon.
chars.note: Also 'regard as': 视为. Traditional 視.

chars.parts: 夫 grown man + 见 see
chars.story: A grown man who sees how things should go: a rule.
chars.note: Traditional 規. Also 'compass' for drawing circles: 圆规.

chars.parts: 十 ten + 目 eye + 𠃊 corner
chars.story: An eye sighting along a stick held out: dead straight.
chars.note: Before a verb: 'keep on': 一直走 'go straight on'.

groups.title: mouth 口 and box 囗
groups.note: Small 口 is a mouth; big 囗 is a box drawn round something.

chars.story: An open mouth.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. Also a counter: 三口人 'three people'.

chars.parts: 口 mouth + 口 mouth + 口 mouth
chars.story: Three mouths tasting the wares: goods.
chars.note: Also 'quality, grade': 品质.

chars.story: A mouth calling out the next in line: a serial number.
chars.note: After a date or room: 五号 'the 5th', 三号 'No. 3'. Traditional 號.

chars.story: A spiral winding back on itself: return.
chars.note: Also a counter for times: 一回 'once'.

chars.story: A frame drawn round a winter scene: a picture.
chars.note: Also 'plan, try to': 试图. Traditional 圖: 啚 inside became 冬.

groups.title: right hand 又
groups.note: 又 is a right hand.

chars.story: A hand reaching out once more: again.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. 又 is 'again' for what has happened; 再 is for what will.

chars.story: A hand pushing back against a cliff: against.
chars.note: Also 'turn over, reverse'.

chars.parts: 爫 hand + 冖 cover + 又 hand
chars.story: One hand passes a thing down to another: accept.
chars.note: Also 'suffer, undergo': 受伤 'be injured'.

chars.story: A hand at it again and again: it changes.
chars.note: Traditional 變: the top of silk and words became 亦.

groups.title: heart 心 and feeling
groups.note: 心 or 忄 shows feeling. In 爱 the heart has been dropped.

chars.story: All of it reaching down to the heart: feel.

chars.parts: 丷 two dots + 口 mouth + 心 heart
chars.story: Every voice and every heart gathered into one: overall.
chars.note: Also 'always': 总是. Traditional 總: 纟 silk on the left was dropped.

chars.story: A heart leaping up: quick.
chars.note: His reading card had 'pleased', as in 快乐 'happy'. Mostly 'quick': 快点! 'hurry!'

chars.parts: 爫 hand + 冖 cover + 友 friend
chars.story: A hand reaching over a cover to a friend: love.
chars.note: Traditional 愛: the heart 心 in the middle was replaced by 友 'friend'.

groups.title: time words
groups.note: Now, once more, only then, often.

chars.parts: 人 roof + 一 one + 乛 hook
chars.story: A roof over this one moment: now.

chars.parts: - a frame with a beam laid across it twice
chars.story: One more beam laid over the frame: once more.
chars.note: For the future: 明天再来 'come again tomorrow'.

chars.parts: - a sprout just breaking the ground
chars.story: A sprout that has only just broken the surface: only then.
chars.note: Also 'talent': 人才. Before a number: 'only': 才三岁.

chars.story: A banner of cloth hung out day after day: often.
chars.note: Also 'ordinary, usual': 正常, 日常.

groups.title: numbers and amounts
groups.note: Big numbers, few and many, money.

chars.story: A cross: all ten fingers, one stroke each way.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.parts: - 萬 cut down to three strokes
chars.story: A scorpion's brood, too many to count: ten thousand.
chars.note: Big numbers go by 万: 三万 '30,000'. Traditional 萬.

chars.parts: 小 small + 丿 a stroke off
chars.story: Small, with one more stroke taken away: few.
chars.note: Also 'young': 少年 'youth'.

chars.parts: 日 sun + 一 one + 里 village
chars.story: Measuring the village's grain under the sun: the amount.
chars.note: Also 'measure': 测量.

chars.story: A head on two legs, the first of all: the base unit of money.
chars.note: Also 'first, basic': 元素. 欧元 'euro'.

chars.parts: - nuggets buried under a roof of earth
chars.story: Nuggets buried in the earth under a roof: gold.
chars.note: Also 'money' and 'metal'.

groups.title: directions
groups.note: North, south, toward, and the line between.

chars.parts: 匕 person + 匕 person, back to back
chars.story: Two people sitting back to back, turned from the cold: north.

chars.parts: - a shelter open to the sun, warmth inside
chars.story: A shelter open to the sun, warm within: south.
A window cut in the wall, facing one way: toward.
chars.note: Before a place or person: 'to, toward': 向前走 'walk forward'.

chars.story: A line laid between two fields: the boundary.
chars.note: After a group: 'circles': 各界 'all walks of life'.

groups.title: buildings and bodies
groups.note: Gates, courts and halls: the places that run things.

chars.parts: - 門 cut down to three strokes
chars.story: A gate with its two doors, cut down to three strokes.
chars.note: His card is 門. Also 'field, branch': 部门 'department'.

chars.story: A walled yard built complete on raised ground: a courtyard.
chars.note: After a word, an institution: 医院 'hospital'.

chars.parts: 广 lean-to + 付 hand over
chars.story: A hall where people hand over their taxes: the government seat.
chars.note: Almost only in 政府 'government'.

chars.story: An altar to the god of the earth, where the village gathers: society.

chars.parts: - a bent arm over 口 mouth
chars.story: A mouth giving orders under a raised arm: take charge.
chars.note: Mostly in 公司 'company' and 司机 'driver'.

groups.title: war and power
groups.note: Fighting, armies, power, strength.

chars.story: A halberd taking ground: war.
chars.note: Traditional 戰: 單 on the left became 占.

chars.story: Chariots drawn up under cover: an army.
chars.note: Traditional 軍: 車 became 车.

chars.story: A hand on the wooden beam of the scales: the power to weigh.
chars.note: Traditional 權: 雚 on the right became 又.

chars.parts: 弓 bow + 口 mouth + 虫 insect
chars.story: A bow strung with the insect's silk: strong.
chars.note: Also 'force': 强迫 'compel'.

groups.title: walking feet 夂
groups.note: 夂 is a foot coming down from above.

chars.story: Feet and strength set to the job: an affair to attend to.
chars.note: Traditional 務: 矛 and 攵 on top were dropped.

chars.story: Feet stopping at the marked spot to settle the matter: deal with.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'dwell'. As a noun, 'place': 到处 'everywhere'.

chars.story: Feet arriving at each doorway in turn: each.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

groups.title: terrace 台
groups.note: 台 is a raised platform; it appears on the right of 治 and 始.

chars.parts: 厶 a twist + 口 mouth
chars.story: A raised stand with a step up to it: a platform.
chars.note: Simplifies 臺 'terrace' and 颱 'typhoon'. 台湾 is Taiwan.

chars.story: Raising platforms to hold the floodwater back: govern.
chars.note: Also 'treat' an illness: 治病.

chars.story: A woman on the birthing platform: a life begins.

groups.title: roads
groups.note: Carts, roads, stops and moving goods.

chars.story: A cart seen from above, axle and wheels: a vehicle.
chars.note: Traditional 車: cut down to four strokes.

chars.story: Each foot treading the same way: a road.
Standing on the spot you have taken: a stop, a station.
chars.note: Also 'stand': 站起来 'stand up'.

chars.story: Clouds carried along the road: transport.
chars.note: Also 'luck, fate': 运气. Traditional 運: 軍 became 云.

groups.title: together
groups.note: Allies, shared things, and things passed between.

chars.story: Ears pressed close together: allies who hear each other.
chars.note: Traditional 聯.

chars.parts: 廿 a thing held up + 八 two hands
chars.story: Two hands raising one thing together: shared.
chars.note: 共产党 is the Communist Party.

chars.parts: - a man with his legs crossed
chars.story: A man with legs crossed: things crossing from hand to hand.
chars.note: Also 'cross' and 'make friends': 交朋友.

groups.title: base and method
groups.note: What a thing stands on, where it came from, its form and its craft.

chars.story: Baskets of earth tamped down: the base.

chars.parts: 厂 cliff + 泉 spring (cut down)
chars.story: A spring rising under a cliff: the source, the original.
chars.note: Also 'plain, field': 草原 'grassland'.

chars.story: A carpenter's square and a stake: the set form, the style.
chars.note: After a word: '-style': 中式 'Chinese-style'.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 丶 a mark
chars.story: A tree with one neat cut in it: a craftsman's skill.
chars.note: Traditional 術: the 行 around it was dropped.

groups.title: pointing words
groups.note: It, oneself, the other, and a name-maker.

chars.story: A creature curled up under a roof: it.
chars.note: 他 'he', 她 'she', 它 'it'.

chars.story: A cord coiled back on itself: oneself.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. Lookalikes: 己 oneself, 已 already, 巳 snake.

chars.story: A knife cutting one piece away from the rest: the other.
chars.note: Before a verb: 'don't': 别走 'don't go'.

chars.story: An axe and a basket: an old word for 'this', now a building block of foreign names.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'this'. Modern prose uses it mostly in foreign names: 俄罗斯 'Russia'.

groups.title: deciding
groups.note: Choose, decide, take apart the problem.

chars.story: Walking ahead to be first to pick: choose.
chars.note: Traditional 選.

chars.story: Ice splitting with one clean crack: decide.
chars.note: Traditional 決 had 氵 water; now 冫 ice.

chars.parts: 角 horn + 刀 knife + 牛 ox
chars.story: A knife freeing the horn from the ox: take apart, untie.
chars.note: Also 'solve' and 'understand': 解决, 了解.

groups.title: silk 纟
groups.note: 纟 is twisted silk: threads gathered and tied.

chars.story: Silk threads gathered into one full skein: unify.
chars.note: Traditional 統.

chars.story: Silk cords tied together in a bundle: a group.
chars.note: Traditional 組.

groups.title: roof 宀
groups.note: 宀 is a roof.

chars.story: A woman safe under the roof: at peace.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. Also 'install': 安装.

chars.story: The house built up to its last beam: finish.
chars.note: After a verb: done: 吃完 'finish eating'.

groups.title: grain 禾
groups.note: 禾 is a stalk of grain.

chars.story: Grain measured out by the dipper and sorted by type: a branch.
chars.note: Also a section of an office or hospital: 内科 'internal medicine'.

chars.story: Grain laid out step by step for inspection: a procedure.

groups.title: water 水 氵
groups.note: 水 is flowing water; on the left it is 氵.

chars.parts: - a stream with spray on both sides
chars.story: A stream with spray flying off both sides: water.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: Water every way you look: the sea.

groups.title: tap 攵
groups.note: 攵 is a hand with a stick: making something happen.

chars.story: A tap sends it off in any direction: let go.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. Also 'put': 放在桌上 'put on the table'.

chars.story: Tapping yourself into a new shape: alter.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'correct' (改过). Now mostly 'change, reform'.

groups.title: lead and manage
groups.note: Guiding and running things.

chars.story: A hand leading a coiled rope forward: lead.
chars.note: Traditional 導: 道 'way' on top became 巳.

chars.story: An official with his bamboo pipe, running everything: manage.
chars.note: Also 'tube, pipe': 血管 'blood vessel'.

groups.title: shadow and display
groups.note: Images and spreading things out.

chars.story: Sunlight on a scene, streaks cast behind it: a shadow.
chars.note: Also 'image, film': 电影, 影片.

chars.parts: 尸 body + a bundle laid flat
chars.story: A body stretched out flat on the ground: spread out.
chars.note: Also 'exhibition': 展览.

groups.title: single shapes
groups.note: Pictures that do not break down.

chars.parts: - a body seen from the side, belly forward
chars.story: A body seen from the side, belly out: body.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'body / self'.

chars.parts: - an old man with long hair and a stick
chars.story: An old man with long hair, leaning on a stick: old.
chars.note: Before a surname: friendly 'old': 老王.

chars.parts: - an arrow landing on the ground
chars.story: An arrow coming down flat on the ground: as far as it goes, until.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'arrive'. Now mostly 'up to, until'.

chars.parts: - a balance with its arms level
chars.story: A balance with its arms dead level: flat.
chars.note: Also 'calm, ordinary': 平安, 平常.

sentences.en: He was standing at the door.
I rarely go to the movies.
They decided to choose him to be president.
I want to finish the work on my own.
As for the papers, I have custody of them.

sentences.zh: 此地为两军再次交战之地。
sentences.en: That was where the two armies would fight again.

sentences.zh: 这个问题不能以常规方法解决。
sentences.en: You cannot solve this problem with the usual method.

sentences.zh: 我们的身体会对我们的感情做出反应。
sentences.en: Our bodies respond to our feelings.

sentences.zh: 科学发明并不总是使世界变得更美好。
sentences.en: Scientific discoveries don't always make the world a better place.
